subject: Budget owner nomination + security & procurement pathing (Bluepoint Labs)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bluepointlabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Budget owner nomination + security & procurement pathing (Bluepoint Labs)

Hi Sarah — thanks again for a great discovery this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Summary of needs (from call)
- GenAI assistant for customer support triage (priority): 1M monthly tokens average, burst to 5M/day during peak
- Data residency & audit logs required for troubleshooting and compliance
- Target production pilot: Q4; procurement decision goal: end of August

What we need from you to advance the pilot
1) Nominate the economic/budget owner who owns P&L signoff or budget allocation (name + email).
2) Security contact for the security questionnaire (SOC2, logging, encryption).
3) Any procurement/contract cadence or required PO process we should know about.

Suggested mutual action plan (MAP)
- This week (by Fri): you nominate budget owner & security contact; we share pilot SOW and a short technical annex.
- Week of Jul 21: 30-min intro call with budget owner + security to align on scope & success metrics.
- Aug: procurement/legal review; finalize pricing and SOW.

Attached: Bluepoint_MAP-v1.pdf (simple mutual-action-plan) — it outlines milestones and decision owners. Also attached is a procurement-timeline-template we can adapt.

If you can share the budget owner contact, I’ll draft an intro email that includes a one-page cost estimate and the pilot SOW for legal. Proposed times for the intro call: Wed 7/23 10–11am PT or Thu 7/24 2–3pm PT. Which works best?

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mailto:tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0129
https://www.redwood.inference.com
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bluepointlabs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Budget owner nomination + security & procurement pathing (Bluepoint Labs)

Hi Tessa — thanks for the clear recap and MAP, this is helpful.

Quick answers: we will nominate our budget owner and security lead by end of week. Preliminary stakeholders:
- Chris Parnell (Director of Finance) — chris.parnell@bluepointlabs.com (likely budget owner)
- Maya Singh (Head of IT Security) — maya.singh@bluepointlabs.com (security questionnaire owner)

Procurement/contract notes:
- We typically require a short SOW + standard services addendum; target review cycle is 2–3 weeks once legal receives the SOW.
- We use DocuSign for signature and require our supplier to add a standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA).

I’ll confirm officially with Chris and Maya and loop them into the intro. Wed 7/23 10am PT should work for all (I’ll propose internally).

Also: Please send the draft SOW and a 1-page cost estimate for pilot so Chris has numbers ahead of the intro.

Best,
Sarah

--
Sarah Liu
Head of Product Operations | Bluepoint Labs
sarah.liu@bluepointlabs.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget owner nomination + security & procurement pathing (Bluepoint Labs)

Nice — Sarah moved quickly. I’ll take the SOW + cost estimate action. Proposed internal plan:
- I will draft Redwood_SOW-draft.docx focused on a 6-week pilot (upto 1M tokens/day average, auto-burst to 5M/day; support SLA: 99.9 uptime).
- Marissa, can you prepare a one-page price summary (pilot price + committed monthly tier) and include a short note on typical payment terms?
- Olga, can your team pre-assemble SOC2 evidence pointers (certs, logging descriptions) so we can attach an appendix for Maya?

I’ve attached the procurement-timeline-template.xlsx and will attach the SOW draft in my next email. If Tessa can confirm the exact success metrics we'll include (CSAT lift / median latency / error rate thresholds), I will bake them into the SOW.

Also recommend we add a single Legal reviewer from our side on the HubSpot deal for faster turnaround — Marissa, can you tag legal once we have Chris’ contact?

–Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com | +1 (650) 555-0147
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bluepointlabs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Chris Parnell <chris.parnell@bluepointlabs.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@bluepointlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Budget owner nomination + security & procurement pathing (Bluepoint Labs)

Tessa / Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround. I’ve spoken with Chris and Maya; they’re happy to join a short intro on Wed 7/23 at 10am PT. I’ve added them above.

Action items from Bluepoint side:
- Chris will lead finance discussions and review the pilot cost estimate.
- Maya requested the SOC2 pointer document and a short note on encryption/key management (she asked for AES-256 & KMS integration details).
- We prefer DocuSign for signature and can expedite once SOW + DPA are supplied.

Link to our procurement portal and placeholder DocuSign for initial contract: https://www.docusign.com/bluepoint/contract/BP-447

I’ll expect the SOW + one-pager pricing by EOD tomorrow so Chris can review before the intro.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Sarah
